reason: Implements 18 GTM account/container/workspace, tag, trigger, audit and release tools against googleapis Tag Manager v2; also exposes Google Ads tools on the same server.
exposure: All seven imported tool arrays register unconditionally, including all Google Ads tools; credentials are loaded lazily inside handlers.
limitations: Only offline MCP initialize/tools/list was executed with an empty environment and isolated HOME; no handler, credential lookup or remote GTM/Ads operation was invoked.
GTM list handlers do not paginate, so audits and lists may cover only the first API page.
gtm_fix_conversion_tag_trigger always creates a fresh trigger, and its message can overstate exclusive event firing when other triggers remain.
gtm_publish returns published:true without interpreting compilerError.

Google Ads auxiliary product defects: audience mode is ignored, add_geo_target does not apply its promised presence-only settings, audit_conversion_goals fabricates zero activity, and PMax image creation supplies full_size.url without image bytes.

Pinned google-ads-api dependency exposes no adGroupAds.appeal implementation (rg source inspection), so gads_request_ad_review returns notAppealable; other Google Ads runtime behavior was not verified.
Several description-only copy length/file-format constraints are not enforced by the exposed schema; schemas retain the actual registration constraints.
GTM client requests edit.containers and publish scopes but omits edit.containerversions; version creation needs credentials granting that scope.

tools.name: gtm_audit_container
tools.description: Comprehensive container audit — finds broken tags, duplicate tags, misfiring conversion tags, tags missing triggers, and tags firing too broadly. Returns a health score 0–100.
tools.behavior: Lists tags, triggers and variables and calculates a heuristic score from missing triggers/types, duplicate names and conversion-like tags on a named All Pages trigger.

tools.name: gtm_find_misfiring_conversion_tags
tools.description: Find conversion/purchase tags that are firing too broadly (e.g. on All Pages instead of a specific event). This is the most common GTM billing/analytics issue.
tools.behavior: Classifies conversion-like tag names as misfiring when attached to PAGEVIEW or named All Pages triggers.

tools.name: gtm_fix_conversion_tag_trigger
tools.description: Fix a misfiring conversion tag by replacing its broad trigger (e.g. All Pages) with a specific Custom Event trigger. Creates the new trigger if needed.

eventName.description: Custom event name to fire on (e.g. "purchase_confirmed")

removeBroadTriggers.description: Remove All Pages / broad triggers from this tag

tools.behavior: Always creates a new Custom Event trigger, optionally removes PAGEVIEW/All Pages triggers and updates the tag; it does not reuse an existing event trigger.

tools.name: gtm_list_workspaces
tools.description: List workspaces in a GTM container
tools.behavior: Lists workspaces belonging to the supplied container.

tools.name: gtm_get_workspace_status
tools.description: Get pending (unsaved) changes in a workspace before publishing
tools.behavior: Fetches workspace changes and conflicts through getStatus.

tools.name: gtm_create_version
tools.description: Create a container version from current workspace changes
tools.behavior: Creates a container version from the supplied workspace with a name and optional notes.

tools.name: gtm_publish
tools.description: Publish the current workspace — makes all changes live immediately
tools.behavior: Creates a new version and publishes it, returning compilerError without checking it before reporting published true.

tools.name: gads_list_conversion_actions

tools.behavior: Google Ads: executes GAQL query using the supplied parameters.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

tools.behavior: Google Ads: executes conversionActions.update using the supplied parameters.

tools.name: gads_update_campaign_budget

dailyAmountUsd.description: New daily budget in USD (e.g. 50 for $50/day).

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

tools.behavior: Google Ads: executes campaignBudgets.update using the supplied parameters.

tools.name: gads_audit_conversion_goals
tools.description: Audit all Google Ads conversion goals — find misconfigured counting types, inactive conversions, and conversions with no recent activity. Returns a prioritized fix list.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

tools.behavior: Google Ads: queries static conversion action data but initializes activity and conversion counts to false/zero without querying recent activity.

tools.name: gads_get_account_performance
tools.description: Get top-level Google Ads account performance — impressions, clicks, cost, conversions for a date range. Quick health check for ad spend efficiency.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

tools.behavior: Google Ads: executes GAQL query using the supplied parameters.

tools.name: gads_set_campaign_status
tools.description: Set a Google Ads campaign status to ENABLED or PAUSED. Use ENABLED to (re)enable a paused campaign — this is the enable capability the server previously lacked (only pause existed), so agents no longer need the UI to resume a campaign. Refs #5444.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

tools.behavior: Google Ads: executes campaigns.update using the supplied parameters.

tools.name: gads_remove_keyword
tools.description: Remove (pause) a keyword from an ad group.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

tools.behavior: Google Ads: pauses the keyword criterion rather than removing it.

tools.name: gads_remove_campaign_criterion
tools.description: Remove a campaign-level criterion (targeted location/geo, placement, or keyword) by its criterion ID. Use to stop targeting a geo that is bringing invalid traffic — e.g. remove a positively-targeted country. Note: you cannot add a NEGATIVE location for a geo that is positively targeted; remove the positive criterion instead.

campaignId.description: Campaign ID that owns the criterion

criterionId.description: Criterion ID to remove (campaign_criterion.criterion_id). For a geo target this is the geo_target_constant id, e.g. 2356 for India.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

tools.behavior: Google Ads: executes campaignCriteria.remove using the supplied parameters.

tools.name: gads_add_negative_placement
tools.description: Add a negative PLACEMENT (website URL or mobile app) exclusion to a campaign so ads never serve there. Use to block click-fraud / low-quality placements (e.g. qureka.com, omegleweb.io, junk Google Play apps).

campaignId.description: Campaign ID to add the exclusion to

placementUrl.description: Placement to exclude — a website URL (e.g. "qureka.com") or app id.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

tools.behavior: Google Ads: executes campaignCriteria.create using the supplied parameters.

tools.name: gads_set_conversion_goal_inclusion
tools.description: Control whether a conversion action counts toward the primary "Conversions" metric (and thus Smart Bidding). Set biddable=false to keep an action TRACKED but stop it optimizing bids — the fix for a PAGE_VIEW action inflating conversions. Operates on the customer-level conversion goal for the action category.

biddable.description: true = include in Conversions metric / bidding; false = tracked only, excluded from bidding.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

tools.behavior: Google Ads: finds the conversion action category and updates all customer goals for that category across origins.

tools.name: gads_list_recommendation_subscriptions
tools.description: List Google Ads auto-apply recommendation subscriptions (type + status). ENABLED means that recommendation type auto-applies without review — the mechanism that can silently raise budgets/bids. Use to audit what auto-applies.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

tools.behavior: Google Ads: executes query using the supplied parameters.

tools.name: gads_set_recommendation_subscription
tools.description: Turn Google Ads auto-apply recommendations ON or OFF. Set enabled=false to PAUSE (stop auto-applying — recommendations are still suggested, just not applied automatically). Pass all=true to apply to every resolvable subscription (the fix for runaway auto-applied budget/bid changes). Subscriptions with an UNKNOWN type/resource name cannot be mutated by the API and are skipped and reported.

enabled.description: true = ENABLED (auto-apply on); false = PAUSED (auto-apply off).

all.description: If true, apply to every resolvable subscription. Ignores resourceName.

resourceName.description: Specific subscription resource_name to set (from gads_list_recommendation_subscriptions). Required when all is not true.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

tools.behavior: Google Ads: updates specific or all resolvable recommendation subscriptions and skips resources ending in /UNKNOWN.

tools.name: gads_create_campaign
tools.description: Create a NEW Google Ads campaign with its own dedicated budget. Handles the full create correctly: makes a non-shared CampaignBudget first, then the campaign referencing it, with network settings (Search Partners OFF, Display Expansion OFF) and MAXIMIZE_CONVERSIONS bidding. Defaults to PAUSED so you review before it serves. Refs #5739.

name.description: Campaign name (also used for the budget name).

status.description: ENABLED to serve immediately (after ad review), PAUSED to review first. Default PAUSED.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

tools.behavior: Google Ads: creates a dedicated budget then a Search/Display campaign with explicit network settings; partial creations are not rolled back.

tools.name: gads_create_ad_group
tools.description: Create an ad group inside a campaign. Refs #5740.

campaignId.description: Campaign ID to add the ad group to.

channel.description: SEARCH_STANDARD or DISPLAY_STANDARD ad group type.

cpcBidUsd.description: Optional default max CPC bid in USD.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

tools.behavior: Google Ads: executes adGroups.create using the supplied parameters.

tools.name: gads_create_responsive_search_ad
tools.description: Create a Responsive Search Ad in an ad group. 3–15 headlines (≤30 chars), 2–4 descriptions (≤90 chars), and final URL(s). Validates lengths before sending. Refs #5741.

adGroupId.description: Ad group ID to add the ad to.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

tools.behavior: Google Ads: executes adGroupAds.create using the supplied parameters.

tools.name: gads_add_geo_target
tools.description: Add a geographic target (or exclusion) to a campaign, using PRESENCE-only targeting by default (people IN the location, not merely interested) — this is the India-fraud-safe setting. Pass negative:true to exclude a geo. Common geo IDs: 2840=US, 2826=UK, 2124=CA, 2036=AU, 2276=DE, 2356=India. Refs #5742.

negative.description: true = exclude this geo. Default false (positive target).

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

tools.behavior: Google Ads: creates a location campaign criterion; despite its description it does not change presence-only geo settings.

tools.name: gads_set_presence_only
tools.description: Set a campaign to PRESENCE-only geo targeting (target users physically IN the targeted locations, not those merely interested). This is the setting that prevents the India interest-traffic fraud. Refs #5742.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

tools.behavior: Google Ads: executes campaigns.update using the supplied parameters.

tools.name: gads_add_negative_keyword
tools.description: Add a negative keyword at the CAMPAIGN level (blocks the term across the campaign). Refs #5743.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

tools.behavior: Google Ads: executes campaignCriteria.create using the supplied parameters.

tools.name: gads_search
tools.description: Run a read-only GAQL query and return rows — for looking up campaign/budget/ad_group/criterion IDs without the google-ads MCP. SELECT queries only. Refs #5745.

gaql.description: A GAQL SELECT query, e.g. "SELECT campaign.id, campaign.name FROM campaign".

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

tools.behavior: Google Ads: rejects queries without an initial SELECT keyword then runs a GAQL query.

tools.name: gads_upload_image_asset
tools.description: Upload an image file from local disk as a Google Ads image Asset (for Display banners / Responsive Display Ads). Returns the asset resource_name to reference in an ad. Refs #5744.

name.description: Asset name (must be unique in the account).

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

tools.behavior: Google Ads: executes assets.create using the supplied parameters.

tools.name: gads_create_responsive_display_ad
tools.description: Create a Responsive Display Ad in a DISPLAY ad group from uploaded image assets + text. Provide marketing image asset resource_names (landscape 1.91:1) and square (1:1), plus headlines, descriptions, business name, and final URL. Refs #5744.

marketingImageAssets.description: Resource names of landscape (1.91:1) image assets.

squareImageAssets.description: Resource names of square (1:1) image assets.

logoImageAssets.description: Optional square logo image asset resource names.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

tools.behavior: Google Ads: executes adGroupAds.create using the supplied parameters.

tools.name: gads_upload_media_bundle
tools.description: Upload an HTML5 ad ZIP file from disk as a Google Ads MEDIA_BUNDLE asset (for HTML5 display upload ads). The zip must be self-contained (no external refs), define ad.size, include a clickTag, and be <150KB. Returns the asset resource_name. Refs #5744.

filePath.description: Absolute path to a self-contained HTML5 ad .zip.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

tools.behavior: Google Ads: executes assets.create using the supplied parameters.

tools.name: gads_create_html5_ad
tools.description: Create an HTML5 display upload ad (DisplayUploadAd, HTML5_UPLOAD_AD) in a DISPLAY ad group from a previously-uploaded MEDIA_BUNDLE asset. This is the real animated HTML5 creative served via API — no manual UI upload. Note: the account must be eligible for HTML5 upload ads (enforced at create time; a policy error means it is not yet allowlisted). Refs #5744.

mediaBundleAsset.description: resource_name of the uploaded MEDIA_BUNDLE asset (from gads_upload_media_bundle).

finalUrl.description: Landing page URL (must match the clickTag domain).

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

tools.behavior: Google Ads: executes adGroupAds.create using the supplied parameters.

tools.name: gads_set_bidding_strategy
tools.description: Change an existing campaign's bidding strategy (MAXIMIZE_CLICKS, MAXIMIZE_CONVERSIONS, TARGET_CPA, TARGET_ROAS, MANUAL_CPC). CRITICAL: switching a standard strategy with an empty payload is a silent no-op in the client — this tool forces a non-empty sub-field and READS BACK bidding_strategy_type to confirm the swap actually landed. Use MAXIMIZE_CLICKS with a cpcBidCeilingUsd to break a new-campaign cold-start (no conversion history). Refs #5764.

cpcBidCeilingUsd.description: For MAXIMIZE_CLICKS: max CPC ceiling in USD (strongly recommended to avoid runaway CPC). Required for MAXIMIZE_CLICKS.

targetCpaUsd.description: For TARGET_CPA: target cost per acquisition in USD.

targetRoas.description: For TARGET_ROAS: target return on ad spend as a fraction (e.g. 3.0 = 300%).

enhancedCpc.description: For MANUAL_CPC: enable Enhanced CPC. Default false.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

tools.behavior: Google Ads: validates strategy-specific required values, updates the campaign and queries its resulting bidding strategy type.

tools.name: gads_set_ad_group_bid
tools.description: Set the default max CPC bid (USD) on an existing ad group. Use to raise/lower delivery on a specific ad group under Manual CPC / Maximize Clicks. Refs #5764.

cpcBidUsd.description: New default max CPC bid in USD.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

tools.behavior: Google Ads: executes adGroups.update using the supplied parameters.

tools.name: gads_set_keyword_bid
tools.description: Set the max CPC bid (USD) on a specific keyword (ad group criterion). Refs #5764.

adGroupId.description: Ad group ID that owns the keyword.

cpcBidUsd.description: New max CPC bid in USD for this keyword.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

tools.behavior: Google Ads: executes adGroupCriteria.update using the supplied parameters.

tools.name: gads_set_ad_status
tools.description: Set an individual ad's status to ENABLED, PAUSED, or REMOVED (ad_group_ad). Use to pause a throttled/underperforming ad or remove a rejected one without touching the ad group. Refs #5764.

adGroupId.description: Ad group ID that owns the ad.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

tools.behavior: Google Ads: executes adGroupAds.remove, adGroupAds.update using the supplied parameters.

tools.name: gads_request_ad_review
tools.description: Request re-review (appeal) of a disapproved or approved-limited ad via the API. Uses the AdGroupAd appeal (promote to review) mechanism. NOTE: only a subset of policy topics are API-appealable; MISLEADING_AD_DESIGN and some others must still be appealed in the UI — this tool returns a clear notAppealable result in that case rather than pretending it worked. Refs #5764.

adGroupId.description: Ad group ID that owns the ad.

adId.description: Ad ID to request review for.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

tools.behavior: Google Ads: checks for adGroupAds.appeal, returns notAppealable when absent, and otherwise attempts an appeal with errors surfaced.

tools.behavior: Google Ads: executes assets.create, campaignAssets.create using the supplied parameters.

tools.description: Attach an audience segment (user_list resource) to an ad group. mode=OBSERVATION measures the audience without restricting reach; mode=TARGETING restricts serving to it. Refs #5764.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

tools.name: gads_create_conversion_action
tools.description: Create an offline conversion action (type UPLOAD_CLICKS) for importing real outcomes — e.g. "Signup (offline)" or "Paid Subscription (offline)" — keyed by gclid. Returns the conversion action id + resource name to use with gads_upload_click_conversion. Refs #5764.

defaultValueUsd.description: Optional default conversion value in USD.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

tools.behavior: Google Ads: executes conversionActions.create using the supplied parameters.

tools.name: gads_upload_click_conversion
tools.description: Upload an OFFLINE click conversion keyed by gclid — the attribution backbone that ties a real signup/subscription back to the Google Ads click that drove it. Feeds Smart Bidding with real outcomes instead of pageviews. gclid is captured at signup. conversionDateTime must be after the click and in "yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss+|-hh:mm" format. NOTE (2026): Google now routes NEW integrations to the Data Manager API — the legacy ConversionUploadService this calls is limited to existing users and returns a clear "use the Data Manager API" error for new accounts. If you get that error, the account needs the Data Manager path (see #5765). The tool surfaces the real error rather than silently failing. Refs #5764.

gclid.description: Google click ID captured at signup (users.gclid).

conversionDateTime.description: Conversion time, format "yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss+hh:mm" (must be AFTER the click).

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

tools.behavior: Google Ads: invokes legacy conversionUploads.uploadClickConversions with partial_failure and reports partial or thrown errors.

tools.name: gads_create_pmax_campaign
tools.description: ONE-CALL Performance Max "campaign builder": creates a PERFORMANCE_MAX campaign + dedicated budget + an asset group with the required assets (3-15 headlines ≤30, 1 long headline ≤90, 2-5 descriptions ≤90, business name, and marketing/square/logo images by URL), then Google's AI auto-optimizes across Search/Display/YouTube/Gmail. Defaults PAUSED so you review first. This is the closest programmatic equivalent to Google's AI Campaign Builder. Refs #5764.

name.description: Campaign name (also names the budget + asset group).

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

tools.behavior: Google Ads: sequentially creates budget, PMax campaign, image/text assets and asset-group links; images use full_size.url rather than uploaded bytes, and partial creations are not rolled back.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

tools.behavior: Google Ads: executes campaignCriteria.create using the supplied parameters.

review.summary: Audits container configuration, finds broadly triggered conversion tags, and creates replacement event triggers.
review.reason: Implements 18 GTM account/container/workspace, tag, trigger, audit and release tools against googleapis Tag Manager v2; also exposes Google Ads tools on the same server.
